name: ibis Styles Jakarta Sunter
short_description: A 145-room family-friendly hotel in North Jakarta's Sunter business district, about 1 km from Kelapa Gading Mall and Mall of Indonesia, with a kids' pool and 11 meeting rooms.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Jakarta Sunter is a 145-room economy hotel in North Jakarta's Sunter business and residential district, roughly a kilometer from both Kelapa Gading Mall and Mall of Indonesia. The property leans into families and MICE groups, offering a swimming pool with a kids' area, a badminton court, billiards, and 11 meeting rooms plus a ballroom that can hold up to 700 people. Guest reviews are strongly positive overall, citing helpful staff, a family-friendly pool, and good value, though at least one 2024 review flagged a bed bug incident and thin breakfast options -- worth noting alongside the otherwise high review volume.

pros: About 1 km from both Kelapa Gading Mall and Mall of Indonesia
Family-friendly swimming pool with a kids' area and playground
11 meeting rooms plus a ballroom seating up to 700 for MICE groups
Badminton court, billiards, and spa on-site
Consistently high review scores and friendly, cooperative staff
cons: At least one 2024 guest review reported a bed bug and thin breakfast buffet options
Rooms described by some guests as comfortable but on the smaller side for a business hotel
research_highlights: TripAdvisor ranks the hotel highly among Jakarta properties, with reviewers repeatedly praising staff friendliness and the family/kids' pool setup
Strategic North Jakarta location near Kelapa Gading Mall, Mall of Indonesia, and JIExpo Kemayoran suits both shopping-focused leisure travelers and exhibition-related business trips
Sizeable MICE footprint for a budget-tier property, with 11 meeting rooms and a 700-capacity ballroom
research_watchouts: A November 2024 Trip.com review (stayed October 2024) reported no porter service, missing bathroom soap, questionable drinking water, a limited breakfast buffet, and a bed bug on the first night -- an outlier versus the otherwise strong review average, but worth flagging

Airport distance is not stated on the official Accor page; North Jakarta's Sunter district is well east of Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, so allow for a longer drive than hotels closer to the CBD or airport

faqs.question: Is ibis Styles Jakarta Sunter good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel has a swimming pool with a dedicated kids' area and playground, plus a badminton court and billiards, and it sits about 1 km from both Kelapa Gading Mall and Mall of Indonesia for family shopping trips.

faqs.question: Does ibis Styles Jakarta Sunter have meeting facilities?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the property has 11 meeting rooms and a ballroom that can seat up to 700 people, making it one of the larger MICE-capable ibis Styles properties in Jakarta.
